fields.name: keyPrefix
fields.description: 8-character prefix of pm_<prefix>_<secret>; shown and used for lookup. Unique.

fields.name: keyHash
fields.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the full key. Never readable by browser users.

fields.name: sendPreview
fields.description: When false, no prompt preview is stored.

fields.name: lastUsedAt
fields.description: UTC time of the last accepted batch.

fields.name: rateWindowStart
fields.description: Start of the current one-minute rate-limit window (ingest workflow only). Not in PLAN.md; see README.

fields.name: rateWindowCount
fields.description: Accepted requests in the current window (ingest workflow only). Not in PLAN.md; see README.
